newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine fixed investment up 18.6 pct Q3 '96.
newsitem.headline: Argentine fixed investment up 18.6 pct Q3 '96.

text.p: Argentine gross fixed internal investment grew by 18.6 percent in the third quarter of 1996 compared to the same period in 1995, the Economy Ministry said in a report Tuesday.
The rise in investment was propelled most strongly by investment in machines and equipment, which grew by 29.1 percent in the period.
The ratio of investment to output was 21.5 percent in the third quarter of 1996, up from 19.3 percent in the same quarter of the previous year.
Gross fixed internal investment grew by 3.6 percent in the first nine months of the year, despite a 4.2-percent fall in investment in construction.
Investment in machines and equipment rose by 12.8 percent in the first three quarters.
